themes_detail.label: Street Deterioration Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Street condition complaints have spiked 740% THIS WEEK to 148 complaints compared to 17.6 per week average over prior 8 weeks, representing an acute infrastructure crisis affecting Jackson Heights–Elmhurst–Corona residents' safety and mobility.
evidence: 148 street condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 17.6 weekly baseline (740% increase, z-score 28.13)
Street reconstruction is a recurring budget request from community board, indicating long-standing neglect
270 building permits filed in last 90 days with 213 alterations may indicate widespread infrastructure strain
reporting_angles: What triggered this sudden spike—weather damage, deferred maintenance backlog, or failed infrastructure project?
Interview residents about potholes, sidewalk damage, and safety hazards; photograph affected areas
Cross-reference with DOT repair records to understand why fixes aren't keeping pace with complaints

themes_detail.label: Traffic Signal System Breakdown
themes_detail.summary: Traffic signal condition complaints surged 489% two weeks ago to 123 complaints versus 20.9 weekly average, creating potential public safety and transit flow hazards across the district.
evidence: 123 traffic signal complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 20.9 weekly average (489% increase, z-score 9.73)
Correlates with street condition spike, suggesting systemic infrastructure degradation
Community board has filed repeated 'Other capital budget request for DOT' indicating years of deferred intersection maintenance
reporting_angles: Has DOT conducted full audit of signal systems in CD 403?
Interview transportation advocates about accident risk from malfunctioning signals; request crash data

themes_detail.label: Illegal Posting Surge
themes_detail.summary: Illegal posting complaints jumped 1500% THIS WEEK to 4 complaints from 0.2 weekly average, signaling a sudden deterioration in code enforcement or outbreak of graffiti/vandalism activity.
evidence: 4 illegal posting complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly baseline (1500% increase, z-score 8.66)
Coincides with street condition and signal problems, part of broader infrastructure/code enforcement breakdown
Real Time Enforcement complaints also spiked 700% three weeks ago (z-score 5.42)
reporting_angles: Canvas affected neighborhoods to photograph illegal postings and document scope of problem
Is DSNY enforcement capacity stretched due to other city priorities?

themes_detail.label: Unsanitary Conditions and Pests
themes_detail.summary: Pigeon and unsanitary condition complaints spiked sharply THIS WEEK (3 pigeon complaints, 1100% above baseline) and last week (dumpster complaints up 2300%), pointing to deteriorating sanitation oversight and pest control.
evidence: 3 unsanitary pigeon complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average (1100% increase, z-score 6.35)
3 dumpster complaints last week vs. 0.1 weekly average (2300% increase, z-score 8.69)
3 commercial disposal complaints last week vs. 0.4 weekly average (700% increase, z-score 5.42)
reporting_angles: Are restaurants and commercial establishments violating waste disposal rules?
Interview health department about rodent infestation trends; has rat population increased?

themes_detail.label: Panhandling Uptick
themes_detail.summary: Panhandling complaints surged 522% last week to 7 incidents versus 1.1 weekly average, potentially signaling increased street homelessness or economic hardship in the district.
evidence: 7 panhandling complaints last week vs. 1.1 weekly average (522% increase, z-score 5.58)
Coupled with recent stabbing at bus stop reported in news (March 19, 2026), suggests public safety concerns
Community board requests for enhanced NORC (Naturally Occurring Retirement Community) programs indicate unmet social services demand
reporting_angles: Interview residents and business owners about public safety perceptions and panhandling frequency
Check with local homeless services providers about client volume and available resources
